resources.string: Reads the screen aloud. Press its shortcut (for example, holding both volume keys), tap the text to start from, and it reads from there to the end, highlighting each part as it goes. Tap again, or press the shortcut, to stop.\n\nIts voice is generated on the phone, and it has no network access: nothing on your screen leaves the phone.
No text to read on this screen
Lector tells English from Spanish on its own. Tap a voice to hear it.
Lector opens with an accessibility shortcut, such as holding both volume keys. In Accessibility settings, open Lector and turn on its shortcut.
Lector is free software: you can use, study, share and change it under the GNU GPL, version 3 or later. It comes with no warranty.
Hi, I\'m Lector. Tap any text on the screen and I\'ll read it from there to the end.
Hola, soy Lector. Tocá cualquier texto de la pantalla y lo leo desde ahí hasta el final.
